goal: Prepare family-selectable, classification-only execution and safe offline rescoring without provider calls or holdout inspection.
approach: Extend existing runner helpers and CLI with legacy defaults, metadata preflight, mode-aware planning/scoring, and immutable label-only rescoring.
Exercise real CLI subprocesses and exported helpers with synthetic paired datasets in the existing datasets contract.
Document exports and compatibility, then run Specular, focused formatting/lint, and Fixture3 datasets contracts.
decisions: Keep existing readDocuments, datasetHashes, buildRequest, and validateResponse as the implementation basis; add no dependencies.
Preflight reads metadata before any target text loading or provider initialization; all collections must declare development in development-only mode.
Store target identity separately from judgments; rescore appends corrected scores without replacing original snapshot, summaries, or batches.
Legacy snapshots default to semantic-thinness and detect-and-highlight; rescore requires recorded target identity and original summaries.
